question: Is `ghc --make -j1` bitwise-reproducible under hermit --strict (3 runs) and relaxed? Does the -C RTS ticker still cause nondeterminism at -j1, or is -j1 clean by default (no +RTS -C0, no timerfd fix)?
motivation: hermit sequentializes threads (zero parallelism benefit), so -j8 under hermit only wastes memory + context switches. The realistic actionable target is -j1. Confirm whether -j1 already reproduces before investing in ticker determinization for -j8.
workload: 46-module Haskell package (/work/pkg/src/Main.hs), ghc --make -jN -O0, fixed canonical output path
fingerprint: aggregate SHA-256 over sorted *.o files + final linked binary, computed OUTSIDE hermit

unfixed_379feaac.description: clock_getres NULL-res fix ONLY (required for GHC to start under hermit); NO timerfd virtualization -> RTS -C ticker reads host time. Represents current default/main ticker behavior. Built for this experiment in scratch/ghc-j1-unfixed.

fixed_64661f45.description: clock_getres fix + timerfd virtualization (the -C ticker determinization). slot03 release binary.

results_j1.cross_config: ALL six -j1 configurations produce the SAME hash, and it equals the native baseline. At -j1 hermit output is byte-identical to native.

probe_sensitivity_check: The -j8 aggregate hash differs (fixed -j8 = 10e379234dde6358; unfixed/oldstock -j8 = 3/3 DISTINCT), confirming the fingerprint detects real ordering differences; the uniform -j1 hash is a genuine finding, not a stuck probe.

conclusion.clock_getres_fix_needed: YES to run GHC under hermit at all (both modes); still not on origin/main.
conclusion.mechanism: GHC info-table symbol (genSym/Unique) nondeterminism arises only from CONCURRENT symbol generation across multiple parallel compile workers (-j>1). At -j1 a single worker compiles modules sequentially, so symbol order is deterministic regardless of when the -C ticker fires. The ticker perturbs order only when threads race.
conclusion.implication: The realistic hermit target (-j1) is ALREADY bitwise-reproducible with stock/default hermit today (only the clock_getres NULL fix is required for startup). The -C ticker determinization (PR #1187) is NOT needed for -j1; it only matters if one insists on parallel -j>1 builds under hermit, which hermit gains no speed from anyway.

honest_caveats: For THIS workload native -j1 is already reproducible, so hermit adds nothing for reproducibility at -j1 here. Hermit's -j1 value would be for OTHER host-dependent nondeterminism sources (timestamps, absolute paths, /proc, RNG) not exercised by this -O0 fixed-output-path pure-compile workload.
clock_getres NULL-res fix (32f004cd / PR #1164 / #1187 lineage) is still required for any GHC-under-hermit run and is not yet on origin/main.
Scope: single 46-module package, GHC 9.8.4, -O0, one host. Larger/-O2 builds or workloads with TH/plugins may exercise additional nondeterminism; not tested here.
